name: obsidian-vault-copilot
description: Manage a personal Obsidian vault as a software-engineering knowledge base: decisions, to-dos, standups, manager reports, Mermaid diagrams, and reviewed GitHub sync.

vaultName.title: Vault name
vaultName.description: Name of the Obsidian vault this plugin manages, as it appears in `obsidian vaults`. The authoritative copy is written to ~/.claude/obsidian-vault-copilot/config.json by /vault-setup.

vaultPath.title: Vault path
vaultPath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the vault.

githubRepoUrl.title: GitHub repo URL
githubRepoUrl.description: Git remote URL for the vault's GitHub repo (private by default).

managerName.title: Manager name
managerName.description: Your manager's name, used to address status reports.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used for daily-note and report dating.

orgRepoPath.title: Org repo path
orgRepoPath.description: Optional local clone path of a shared org knowledge repo, used by /vault-contribute.
